Nifi-test-v4-Parameters.name: Nifi-test-v4-Parameters
Nifi-test-v4-Parameters.description: Central deployment and operational properties for Nifi-test-v4. Enter sensitive PasswordA and APIKeyC after import. No nested parameter references are used.

parameters.name: ServerA
parameters.description: SFTP host serving source and all destination directories. Host/IP only.

parameters.name: PortA
parameters.description: SFTP port on Server A.

parameters.name: UsernameA
parameters.description: SFTP login shared by 01, 10, 11 and 12.

parameters.name: PasswordA
parameters.description: Enter Windows/Linux SFTP password ONCE after import. Used by all four SFTP processors.

parameters.name: SourceDirectoryA
parameters.description: Fully qualified SFTP source path. Only completed files should be made available here.

parameters.name: PassDirectoryA
parameters.description: Fully qualified SFTP destination for Allowed files.

parameters.name: FailedDirectoryA
parameters.description: Fully qualified SFTP destination for Blocked files.

parameters.name: OthersDirectoryA
parameters.description: Fully qualified SFTP destination for inconclusive/timed-out files.

parameters.name: ServerC
parameters.description: MetaDefender host/IP only; independent of ServerA even when colocated.

parameters.name: ProtocolC
parameters.description: MDC protocol: http for current lab. HTTPS also requires certificate trust configuration.

parameters.name: PortC
parameters.description: MetaDefender API TCP port.

parameters.name: APIPathC
parameters.description: MDC scan resource path, leading slash, no trailing slash.

parameters.name: APIKeyC
parameters.description: Enter current MDC API key ONCE after import. Shared sensitive apikey header on 03 and 06.

parameters.name: WorkflowC
parameters.description: MetaDefender workflow rule selected on submission; must exist and be authorized.

parameters.name: AllowedPrefix
parameters.description: Prefix for copies delivered to Pass.

parameters.name: BlockedPrefix
parameters.description: Prefix for copies delivered to Failed.

parameters.name: OthersPrefix
parameters.description: Prefix for copies delivered to Others.

parameters.name: SFTPConnectTimeout
parameters.description: SFTP connection-establishment timeout.

parameters.name: DownloadDataTimeoutA
parameters.description: SFTP download idle-data timeout on 01; not total file-transfer duration.

parameters.name: UploadDataTimeoutA
parameters.description: SFTP delivery idle-data timeout on 10/11/12.

parameters.name: StrictHostKeyCheckingA
parameters.description: Preserves lab SFTP host-key behavior; true needs host-key configuration.

parameters.name: PickupPollingInterval
parameters.description: GetSFTP remote listing interval. Processor scheduling remains fixed at 10 sec.

parameters.name: PickupMaxSelects
parameters.description: Maximum files fetched per GetSFTP connection.

parameters.name: PickupListingBatchSize
parameters.description: Remote file listing batch size on 01.

parameters.name: PickupFileFilter
parameters.description: GetSFTP filename regex; current value ignores temporary suffixes and leading-dot files.

parameters.name: HTTPConnectTimeoutC
parameters.description: HTTP connection timeout on 03/06.

parameters.name: HTTPReadTimeoutC
parameters.description: HTTP socket-read timeout on 03/06.

parameters.name: HTTPWriteTimeoutC
parameters.description: HTTP socket-write timeout on 03/06; not entire large-upload time.

parameters.name: HTTPResponseMaxBytes
parameters.description: Maximum API report bytes stored in md.response; larger responses are truncated.

parameters.name: PollingMaxRetries
parameters.description: Shared pending-scan/network retry budget; 10-second penalty remains fixed.

parameters.name: SubmissionMaxRetries
parameters.description: Retry budget for submission network/HTTP 5xx errors.

parameters.name: DeliveryMaxRetries
parameters.description: Retry budget for each destination SFTP write.

parameters.name: DestinationConflictResolution
parameters.description: PutSFTP same-name collision behavior. REPLACE preserves current tests.

parameters.name: CreateDestinationDirectories
parameters.description: Allow PutSFTP to create missing destination directories.

parameters.name: DestinationDotRename
parameters.description: Upload under a dot-prefixed temporary name then rename after success.

flowContents.name: Nifi-test-v4
flowContents.comments: V4 PARAMETERIZED working v3.2 password flow. Central context Nifi-test-v4-Parameters: server A credentials and all four SFTP directories; server C protocol/host/port/path/key/workflow; prefixes and operational property tuning. Enter PasswordA and APIKeyC once. GetSFTP source deletion remains after download, before submission. No timestamps, SSH keys or Processing redesign; stop 01 during direct copy. HOLD disabled.

processors.name: 03 Submit original to MetaDefender
processors.comments: V4: APIKeyC is a sensitive parameter, shared by 03 and 06; apikey is marked as a sensitive dynamic HTTP header. No HTTP username/password authentication.

processors.name: 06 Poll scan result — preserve original content
processors.comments: V4: APIKeyC is a sensitive parameter, shared by 03 and 06; apikey is marked as a sensitive dynamic HTTP header. No HTTP username/password authentication.

processors.name: 09 Pass only clean completed allowed scans
10 Copy original to Pass
processors.comments: V4: edit PasswordA once in Parameter Context; do not replace its parameter reference here. Source is already removed by GetSFTP; retain failed/rejected queues.

processors.name: 11 Copy original to Failed
processors.comments: V4: edit PasswordA once in Parameter Context; do not replace its parameter reference here. Source is already removed by GetSFTP; retain failed/rejected queues.

processors.name: HOLD ERRORS — leave disabled; inspect incoming queues
Retry pending scans or poll errors
02 Preserve original source filename
processors.comments: Metadata only: pickup/download/deletion are combined in 01. No password field on this step. Preserve original name before Allowed_/Blocked_/Others_ output prefixes.

processors.name: 12 Copy original to Others
processors.comments: V4: edit PasswordA once in Parameter Context; do not replace its parameter reference here. Source is already removed by GetSFTP; retain failed/rejected queues.

processors.name: 09a Threat or explicit block goes to Failed
09P Prefix Allowed_
processors.comments: Set output prefix from original source filename. Retries do not add the prefix again.

processors.name: 09F Prefix Blocked_
processors.comments: Set output prefix from original source filename. Retries do not add the prefix again.

processors.name: 09O Prefix Others_
processors.comments: Set output prefix from original source filename. Retries do not add the prefix again.

processors.name: 01 Get source files - no timestamp tracking
processors.comments: V4: PasswordA and all SFTP connection/directory values come from Nifi-test-v4-Parameters. Delete Original=true: removes source after fetch, before MDC. Stop during direct copy; no automatic completeness check.
